> Its an off grid radio system with more than 40km of range. Its capable of normal walkie talkie like communication and complete off grid text messaging . It will aslo connect to a smartphone using bluetooth that allowes you to send and recive text on your phone trough this device. This is the pcb part of the desing

## Design

### 2026-10-07 – Ive picked the main components for MeshRanger. For the antenna module i choose a SX1262 Lora SPI 2W  module for the screen a 1.8 inch tft display, for the keyboard and navigation interface a small num

**5h**

Ive picked the main components for MeshRanger. For the antenna module i choose a SX1262 Lora SPI 2W  module for the screen a 1.8 inch tft display, for the keyboard and navigation interface a small number pad and an arrow key array. The brain will be an ESP 32 S3 supermini.
